ruled_by: user (chat, 2026-09-13), in answer to the two options put forward after the metaqa legacy-vs-canonical reproduction check

what_it_settles.axis: entity node text used for the served dense (gte-Qwen2-1.5B) and SPLADE encodings of KB corpora: NAME_ONLY vs NAME_PLUS_FACTS
what_it_settles.previous_status: OPEN -- V1_RETRIEVAL_ROLE_DECISION.json (webqsp) chose ALL_NODE + entity NAME_ONLY as the default arm and left 'NAME_ONLY vs NAME_PLUS_FACTS' explicitly NOT settled; metaqa SOURCE_CONTRACT: triple verbalization is a downstream ENCODING choice, not corpus identity
what_it_settles.now: SETTLED = NAME_ONLY. The KB facts are the STRUCT edges (metaqa: KB triples; webqsp: Freebase edges + CVT record texts), not node text.

why: the facts are not lost: they are the structural graph the partition and the L1 structural hop already consume

verbalising triples into node text makes the retrieval channel perform the hop (legacy hop-1 ANY-gold-in-dense-200 = 0.716 vs 0.147 canonical) -- the wrong layer doing the graph's work; on the canonical layout retrieval finds the topic entity and structure reaches the answer (canonical hop-1 BASE 0.898)
one encoding regime across all six datasets: text corpora encode passages, KB corpora encode entities
re-encoding webqsp (~1M entity nodes) needs a GPU that is not available and would supersede frozen dense/SPLADE shards and top-1000 caches for two datasets

consequences.legacy_kb_l1_cells: historical comparison points on a different encoding (legacy metaqa H4_SPLIT_PRESERVE__SK BASE 0.7863 / F6 0.7888; legacy webqsp cells); not baselines to match
consequences.reproduction_answer: canonical-layout L1 reproduces legacy L1 where the encoding regime is the same (squad paired 1997 rows: SAFE 0.9915 vs 0.9910, p 1.0; BASE 0.982 vs 0.989, p 0.024) and cannot reproduce the KB-corpus cells by construction (metaqa paired 1370 rows: BASE 0.6898 -> 0.5168)
consequences.manifest: RULINGS_PENDING.KB_CORPUS_ENCODING closes at the next freeze_l1.py run (supersession, never an edit)

OPEN_AXIS_NOT_DECIDED_HERE.status: NOT settled by this decision and NOT written into any artifact.
OPEN_AXIS_NOT_DECIDED_HERE.measured_consequence: under ALL_NODE, NAME_PLUS_FACTS serialises every CVT argument twice -- once in the CVT record, again inside each adjacent entity -- costing 2.554x the default arm, for information that is already retrievable as its own unit.
OPEN_AXIS_NOT_DECIDED_HERE.assistant_recommendation_not_a_user_deci: pair ALL_NODE with entity NAME_ONLY. The substitution rationale for NAME_PLUS_FACTS was to compensate for excluding CVTs; once CVTs are eligible the compensation is redundant. NAME_PLUS_FACTS remains the correct rendering for the NO_CVT_RETRIEVAL ablation arm, which is exactly where the substitution hypothesis is under test.
